biggest_catch: The friend must open a checking account AND keep a direct deposit active for a minimum 30-day cycle, and both accounts must stay above zero and in good standing - bonus arrives only after all conditions are verified.
catches: Referrer must be an active Great Erie FCU account holder in good standing; you share your phone number/email with the friend so the CU can identify you.
Friend must be a new member: no Great Erie account in the past 12 months, 18+, not a business entity, and presents the Member Referral Form at initial account opening.
Friend opens a checking account with direct deposit and the DD must be established for a minimum 30-day cycle; $5 Owner Voting Share deposit required for membership.
Bonus paid as a 'bonus dividend' deposited into the referrer's Great Erie savings account; both accounts must have balances above zero and be in good standing.
Cap: up to 10 members per calendar year ($1,000 max).
Bonus dividends may be taxable; program can be terminated at any time.
